questions.question: Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe location?
'The expression 'in front of' is used to describe location in relation to something else' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe location behind something?
'The expression 'next to' is used to describe location in relation to something else' is a True statement.
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe location in relation to something else?
'The expression 'in front of' is used to describe location in relation to something else' is a True statement. (variante 2)
Which of the following is a common English expression used to describe location in relation to something else? (variante 2)
'The expression 'in front of' is used to describe location in relation to something else' is a True statement. (variante 3)
